name: @workspace.sh/workspace
description: App-facing Workspace SDK. One object composing the proven primitives — create/open a workspace, invite members, read/write the encrypted log — so the app codes against a single surface instead of wiring crypto by hand.
_imports_note: Host builtins, mapped per host. Under Bare there is no `fs` builtin — `bare-fs` IS the filesystem module — so this is correct resolution rather than a workaround, and the `bare` condition scopes it to that host. watcher.ts imports these unprefixed and relies on this map; it previously relied on the GLOBAL bare-pack override instead, which works only while this package is bundled by this repo's own build (#335).
